title: Fix incorrect text shader line preview caused by comments

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes #120927

Text shader line preview treated comments as shader code during statement and scope analysis. This could:

- Make a preview use the result of the following assignment.
- Prevent valid assignments from being recognized.
- Make braces or function-like code inside comments affect scope detection.
- Generate wrong preview shaders when using inline or multiline comments.

After files are changed or saved, you always need to manually toggle the shader preview on a row to refresh the display of all shader previews.

## Additional information

This PR strips line and block comments before analyzing and generating the preview shader by `_strip_comments()`, while preserving line breaks and character positions. Comment markers inside quoted strings are preserved `"\\"`.

Brace balancing function `_get_brace_balance()` also ignores braces inside quoted strings `"{ }"`.

In `_validate_script()`, use the raw code from the text editor rather than the preprocessed code to generate the shader preview.

Tested by:

- Prek code style checker.
- Building the Windows editor successfully.
- Testing the MRP from #120927.
- Testing trailing `//` comments.
- Testing inline and multiline `/* ... */` comments.
- Testing comments containing braces, parentheses, and function-like code.
